pages.text: A $(item)spell ring$() comes out of the altar. The second and third rings are made from the one before.

pages.title: Wearing Them
pages.text: I wear them on the right hand, in the order I want them. Two at first, and one more for each tier of the circle. A ring of the first tier has one socket, the second two, the third four.$(br2)Gems go in the sockets: swift, fury, lasting, thrift, reach. A gem pressed to a ring sets itself.
